verdict.rationale: Gitea's own marketing says it syncs with Slack, Discord, MS Teams, Lark and more, and it documents webhooks as an extension mechanism. That points to first-party chat integration, but the evidence never says which events (repository pushes, pull request activity) are sent to these tools or how they are configured. missing for 10: documentation of repository and pull request event notifications to chat tools, configuration details for the Slack/Discord/Teams integrations, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send repository and pull request notifications to chat tools like Slack, Discord, or Microsoft Teams

citations.quote: Sync seamlessly with tools like Slack, Discord, MS Teams, Lark, and more.
Extend Gitea's functionality with our API and webhooks, creating custom workflows to match your unique needs.
